findings.claim: Q2 2026 指引不如預期被歸因於 AXON 模型改進比預期慢，而非廣告主需求下滑；Q3 2026 營收指引 $2.055–2.085B
findings.source: commonthreadco.com — AppLovin Q2 2026: What the AI Model Pause and Record Ecommerce Spending Mean for Your Campaigns
findings.excerpt: The guidance miss came from AXON model improvements moving slower than projected, not from any drop in advertiser demand or platform effectiveness.

findings.claim: 消費者（電商）垂直快速成長，3 月較 1 月約 +25%，4 月創單月紀錄、高於任一 Q4 高峰
findings.source: Hudson Labs — AppLovin Q2 2026 earnings preview
findings.excerpt: The consumer vertical (formerly e-commerce) is scaling rapidly, with March 2026 up ~25% vs. January and April reaching a record month, higher than any Q4 peak.

findings.claim: FUNDA 8 月預覽：成長仍健康但對比基期較高而趨緩，遊戲客戶成長略降、電商客戶表現佳
findings.excerpt: Gaming-client growth eased modestly this quarter, while e-commerce clients performed well.

note: 只找到聚合/部落格類來源，無 Advertising Agencies 產業層級供給紀律資料；供需結構性 vs 週期性僅有第三方零散說法。Q3 2026 實績未查到。第 4 條 as_of 為估計日。
